Sorting by density: unripe berries float, ripe ones sink, and a paddle sends each to its own exit.

Destemmed berries enter a sealed bath whose density the user sets; perforated paddles carry the floating, less ripe berries to one exit and the submerged, riper ones to another, so a batch can be sorted or split by ripeness.
